name: Dreaded Foe (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Fear (aura or cone), Ability Focus (fear [aura or cone]), Intimidate 7 ranks, Cha 13

Benefit(s): If a subject fails its save against your fear effect you can choose to cause that creature to become cowered, frightened or panicked; creatures that make their save are shaken for 1 round.
